messages:
maria: Starting onboarding for Constellation-6B (gptq-int4 converted). Quick smoke shows numeric date shifts and some early <eos>.
ash: Which converter/version and flags? Any token-map overrides?
maria: `./tools/hf_convert.sh --src=orig-ckpt --model=constellation-6b --quant=gptq-int4 --preserve-order true --token-map=auto`
maria: Example: Prompt "When was the moon landing?" -> expected "1969", quantized returns "1979 <eos>" (consistent across seeds).
ash: If tokenizer ids match, suspect proj-order or rotary amplitude bias from quantization rounding.
devon: Also check weight packing endianness — we've seen epoch-era shifts when bytes flipped during pack.
sasha: Token ids? Dump both tokenizer.encode(...) on orig vs converted.
maria: IDs identical. So mapping unlikely. Ops: any logits diffs?
ops: Logged first 8-step logits. EOS logit is ~+2.1 in int4 vs fp32, numeric tokens suppressed by ~0.4-0.9.
devon: That pattern aligns with headwise rotary scale drift moving attention mass. Print per-head rotary norms.
maria: Quick probe: mean angles even heads ~0.97x, odd heads ~1.03x vs fp32 baseline.
nash: Small headwise scale mismatch can amplify EOS. Try runtime rescale factors per-head as a patch.
maria: Applied odd-head multiplier 0.97 -> EOS prob drops; numeric token ranks recover but some long-tail tokens increase.
sasha: Check kv-cache projection slices - if proj-order swapped you can circular-shift keys for some heads.
ops: KV values show headwise circular shift of 1 on projection slices; converter likely swapped proj order for packing.
devon: Root cause likely two compounding issues: converter changed proj-order + quant rounding shifted rotary per-head scales.
maria: Short-term plan: 1) force preserve proj-order in converter, 2) run per-head rotary calibration post-quant and write corrections, 3) add small canonical prompt unit tests for numerics/dates.
nash: For calibration compute s_h = mean_fp32 / mean_quant per head and save as `rotary_corrections.json` to apply at runtime.
triage-bot: INF-4620 opened, assigned to @maria, tags: model-onboard, quant, rotary.
ops: Quick eval: 500 prompts, metrics: numeric top1, avg EOS position delta. Results: float32 top1=0.912, raw int4=0.782, proj-preserve=0.865, proj+rotary-corr=0.901.
devon: Nice gains. Please upload CSV and examples where decade shifts occur.
maria: Uploaded CSV + gist with per-head tables and a tiny script to apply runtime corrections. Will open PR to converter to add `--rotary-calibrate` and a post-quant unit test.
sasha: Long-term: add invariants in conversion CI to assert per-head rotary mean within tolerance and a small golden prompt suite.
ash: Agree. Ops, keep float32 fallback pinned on production route until conversion fix lands.
ops: Will monitor telemetry and rollback if regressions spike.
maria: Will update INF-4620 when PR lands. Thanks all :rocket:
